fact: At a 31 October 2025 ceremony in Bangui the field team demonstrated the dematerialised civil registration process, which registered more than 125 children, with late-registration operations to continue in Bangui's 8th, 6th, 5th and 3rd arrondissement centres and then in more than 44 communes.
title: RCA : 2980 actes de naissance remis dans quatre quartiers du 8ᵉarrondissement de Bangui et lancement d’une seconde campagne d’enregistrement tardif des naissances
